subject: Chemistry
title: Practical Chemistry
summary: Organic compounds mein extra elements (N, S, halogens) Lassaigne ke sodium fusion extract se detect hote hain; functional groups (alcohol, phenol, aldehyde, carboxyl, amine) simple colour ya precipitate tests se pehchaante hain.
Inorganic salt analysis mein ek cation aur ek anion dhoondhte hain: anions ke liye dilute aur concentrated H₂SO₄ tests, phir group reagents cations ko group 0 se VI mein baant-te hain.
KMnO₄ ki oxalic acid aur Mohr's salt ke saath redox titration mein indicator nahi chahiye — KMnO₄ khud indicator hai (colourless se permanent halka gulabi).
Lab preparations (Mohr's salt, potash alum, acetanilide, p-nitroacetanilide, aniline yellow, iodoform) aur har step ki chemistry NEET ke common sawal hain.

formulas.name: KMnO₄ vs oxalic acid
formulas.mistake: Oxalic acid ko 60–70 °C tak garam karo; room temperature par reaction dheemi hai (bana Mn²⁺ phir use catalyse karta hai — autocatalysis) — thanda mat chalao.

formulas.name: KMnO₄ vs Mohr's salt
formulas.mistake: Thande mein karo — garam karne se hawa Fe²⁺ ko oxidise kar degi, galat answer aayega.

formulas.name: Molarity equation for titration
formulas.formula: M₁V₁/n₁ = M₂V₂/n₂ (n = stoichiometric coefficient)  or  N₁V₁ = N₂V₂

formulas.name: Equivalent weight in acid medium
formulas.formula: KMnO₄: n-factor 5 (Mn⁺⁷ → Mn²⁺);  oxalic acid: 2;  Mohr's salt (Fe²⁺): 1

formulas.name: Dilute H₂SO₄ group (anions)
formulas.formula: CO₃²⁻ → CO₂ (lime water milky);  S²⁻ → H₂S (lead acetate paper black);  SO₃²⁻ → SO₂ (acidified K₂Cr₂O₇ green);  NO₂⁻ → brown NO₂

formulas.name: Conc. H₂SO₄ group (anions)
formulas.formula: Cl⁻ → HCl (white fumes with NH₃);  Br⁻ → reddish-brown Br₂;  I⁻ → violet I₂;  NO₃⁻ → brown ring test;  CH₃COO⁻ → vinegar smell
formulas.note: Brown ring [Fe(H₂O)₅NO]²⁺ hai, conc. H₂SO₄ ke junction par.

formulas.name: SO₄²⁻ and PO₄³⁻
formulas.formula: SO₄²⁻ + BaCl₂ → white BaSO₄ (insoluble in HCl);  PO₄³⁻ + ammonium molybdate (HNO₃) → canary-yellow precipitate

formulas.name: Cation groups
formulas.formula: 0: NH₄⁺ (NaOH, heat → NH₃);  I: Pb²⁺ (dil. HCl);  II: Pb²⁺, Cu²⁺, As³⁺ (H₂S in acid);  III: Fe³⁺, Al³⁺ (NH₄OH + NH₄Cl);  IV: Co²⁺, Ni²⁺, Mn²⁺, Zn²⁺ (H₂S in basic);  V: Ba²⁺, Sr²⁺, Ca²⁺ ((NH₄)₂CO₃);  VI: Mg²⁺
formulas.mistake: Group II mein acid mein H₂S (kam S²⁻); group IV mein ammoniacal medium mein H₂S (zyada S²⁻) — common ion effect, ulta mat lo.

formulas.name: Flame colours
formulas.formula: Ca brick-red;  Sr crimson;  Ba apple-green;  Cu blue-green;  Na golden-yellow;  K lilac

formulas.name: Functional group tests
formulas.formula: unsaturation: Br₂ water / Baeyer's reagent decolourised;  alcohol: ceric ammonium nitrate (red);  phenol: neutral FeCl₃ (violet);  aldehyde: Tollens', Fehling's;  carbonyl: 2,4-DNP (orange ppt);  carboxyl –COOH: NaHCO₃ (CO₂);  1° amine: carbylamine

formulas.name: Ni²⁺ and Fe³⁺ confirmations
formulas.formula: Ni²⁺ + dimethylglyoxime (NH₄OH) → red precipitate;  Fe³⁺ + K₄[Fe(CN)₆] → Prussian blue;  Fe³⁺ + KSCN → blood red

examples.title: Oxalic acid titration
examples.problem: 25 mL 0.05 M oxalic acid ko acid mein 0.02 M KMnO₄ se titrate kiya. KMnO₄ ka volume?
examples.solution: Oxalic acid ke moles = 0.025 × 0.05 = 1.25 × 10⁻³. MnO₄⁻ chahiye = (2/5) × 1.25 × 10⁻³ = 5 × 10⁻⁴ mol. Volume = 5 × 10⁻⁴/0.02 L = 25 mL.

examples.title: Mohr's salt titration
examples.problem: 20 mL 0.1 M Mohr's salt solution ko 0.02 M KMnO₄ se titrate kiya. KMnO₄ ka volume?

examples.title: Dilute H₂SO₄ kyun?
examples.problem: KMnO₄ titration dilute H₂SO₄ mein kyun, HCl ya HNO₃ mein kyun nahi?
examples.solution: HCl ko KMnO₄ Cl₂ mein oxidise kar deta hai, extra KMnO₄ kharch hota hai. HNO₃ khud oxidising agent hai. Dilute H₂SO₄ na oxidise hota hai na oxidise karta hai.

examples.title: Group reagent logic
examples.problem: Group III mein NH₄OH se pehle NH₄Cl kyun daalte hain?
examples.solution: Common ion NH₄⁺ NH₄OH ka ionisation dabaata hai, OH⁻ itna kam rehta hai ki sirf group III ke hydroxides (Fe³⁺, Al³⁺) precipitate hon, group IV–VI ke (jaise Mg(OH)₂) nahi.

examples.title: Brown ring test
examples.problem: Brown ring kya hai aur kahan banta hai?
examples.solution: Nitrate solution + taaza FeSO₄, phir conc. H₂SO₄ kinaare se daalo. Dono layers ke milne ki jagah [Fe(H₂O)₅NO]²⁺ ka brown ring banta hai.

examples.title: Mohr's salt ki preparation
examples.problem: Mohr's salt banate waqt thoda dilute H₂SO₄ kyun daalte hain?
examples.solution: FeSO₄ (aur Fe²⁺) ka hydrolysis rokne ke liye, warna solution dhundhla ho jaata hai. Zyada der garam na karke Fe²⁺ ko oxidise hone se bhi bachaate hain.

topics.title: Detection of extra elements
topics.explain: Sodium fusion covalent N, S aur X ko ionic NaCN, Na₂S aur NaX mein badalta hai. N: Prussian blue; S: sodium nitroprusside se violet ya kaala PbS; N aur S dono: FeCl₃ se blood red; halogens: AgNO₃ (pehle HNO₃ se CN⁻ aur S²⁻ ubaal kar hatao).

topics.title: Preparation of inorganic compounds
topics.explain: Mohr's salt FeSO₄·(NH₄)₂SO₄·6H₂O aur potash alum K₂SO₄·Al₂(SO₄)₃·24H₂O double salts hain jo equimolar solutions ko crystallise karke bante hain; paani mein apne saare ions ke tests dete hain.

topics.title: Preparation of organic compounds
topics.explain: Acetanilide (aniline + acetic anhydride), p-nitroacetanilide (kam temperature par acetanilide ka nitration), aniline yellow (p-aminoazobenzene, benzenediazonium chloride ka aniline se coupling), iodoform (ethanol ya acetone + I₂ + alkali, peele crystals).

topics.title: Chemistry of titrimetric exercises
topics.explain: Burette reading neeche wale meniscus par (rangeen KMnO₄ ke liye upar wala). KMnO₄ primary standard nahi; oxalic acid se standardise karte hain. End point = pehla permanent halka gulabi rang. Acid–base titrations mein indicator chahiye; KMnO₄ titration (titration) mein nahi.

topics.title: Tests for proteins and carbohydrates
topics.explain: Proteins ke liye Biuret test (violet); saare carbohydrates ke liye Molisch's test (violet ring); starch ke liye iodine test (neela); reducing sugars ke liye Fehling's aur Benedict's.

topics.title: Physical chemistry experiments (JEE)
topics.explain: CuSO₄ ki enthalpy of solution aur strong acid–strong base ki enthalpy of neutralisation (≈ −57 kJ/mol) calorimeter mein q = mcΔT se naapte hain. Lyophilic sols (starch, egg albumin, gum) sirf paani mein garam karke bante hain; lyophobic sols (Fe(OH)₃, As₂S₃) ke liye hydrolysis ya double decomposition jaise khaas tareeke. Iodide ions ki H₂O₂ ke saath reaction ki rate room temperature par follow karte hain (nikli iodine starch ko neela karti hai).

topics.title: Tests for fats and oils
topics.explain: Fats kaagaz par translucent daag chhodte hain; acrolein test (KHSO₄ ke saath garam karne par teekhi gandh) glycerol dikhata hai.

ratta: KMnO₄: self-indicator, colourless → pink; dil. H₂SO₄ only.
Oxalic acid titration: warm 60–70 °C; Mohr's salt: cold.
Group II: H₂S acidic;  group IV: H₂S basic.
Ni²⁺ + DMG → red;  Fe³⁺ + KSCN → blood red.
Brown ring = NO₃⁻;  canary yellow = PO₄³⁻.
Ca brick-red, Sr crimson, Ba apple-green.
